newsitem.title: FINLAND: RALLYING-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION KANKKUNEN JOINS FORD.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION KANKKUNEN JOINS FORD.

text.p: Former world rally champion Juha Kankkunen of Finland will replace German Armin Schwarz at Ford for the remainder of the 1997 world championship season, the company said on Friday.
Kankkunen, world champion in 1986, 1987, 1991 and 1993, will drive a Ford Escort in the Argentinian rally on May 22-24, teaming up with Spaniard Carlos Sainz.
Ford European Motorsport director Martin Whitaker said there had been difficulty with some commercial aspects of the agreement between Schwarz and the team, forcing them to part company.
"We hope that he may still be able to drive a third car for the team in selected events later this year," he said in a statement.

Sainz was second in the Tour of Corsica which ended on Wednesday, and is third overall in the drivers' championship with 18 points behind Finn Tommi Makinen on 28 points and Colin McRae of Britain on 26.
Ford are third in the manufacturers' standings on 29 points behind Subaru on 54 and Mitsubishi on 36 points.
Including the Argentinian rally, eight world championship rallies remain this year.
